content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — P12345: 'us-west-2 AZ3 GPU pool degraded' :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Page generated at 2026-06-07T21:33:09Z. Escalation policy: infra-sev. Trigger: healthcheck-signal > 5m.
maria-ops: saw the alert in the morning run. latency/queue depth climbing for az3-serving nodes.
simon-sre: I'm pulling it. acked on PD. taking initial lead. :wave:
pagerduty: Acknowledged by simon-sre at 2026-06-07T21:34:15Z.
kai-runtime: adding context — autoscaler is reporting scaling errors, and GPU driver restarts on a subset of nodes in az3. Logs show GPU reset events.
maria-ops: customer impact: hosted API token-level increases in 502/503 for requests routed to us-west-2/az3. Most traffic still healthy (az1/az2).
olivia-support: flagged top customers on watchlist and opened support tickets for three affected customers (C123, C456, C789). Drafting status page update.
simon-sre: can someone run a quick node list and pod status for az3 clusters? paste outputs.
kai-runtime: running now — pasted below:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l topology.kubernetes.io/zone=us-west-2-az3 -o wide
NAME                  STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-az3-01           Ready    gpu      42d   v1.25.4
node-az3-02           NotReady gpu      37d   v1.25.4
node-az3-03           Ready    gpu      12d   v1.25.4
```
```
$ kubectl describe node node-az3-02 | grep -i -A3 "gpu"
Events:
  Warning  KernelOops  3m    kubelet  GPU driver crash: GPU reset detected
  Warning  Eviction   2m    kubelet  memory pressure
```
simon-sre: node-az3-02 is flapping; driver resets probably causing pod evictions. rolling restart for gpu-driver daemonset?
kai-runtime: doing a targeted drain and reprovision for node-az3-02. `kubectl drain node-az3-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
maria-ops: note: autoscaler attempted to scale up but failed because new instances hit same driver crash during init. likely infra kernel/AMI issue or faulty NIC/GPU firmware.
olivia-support: status page draft — "We are investigating increased errors for endpoints served from us-west-2 AZ3. Traffic is being rerouted to healthy AZs. Some customers may see elevated error rates. Updates at 5-10 minute intervals." Want me to post now?
simon-sre: yes post. include mitigation steps we're attempting and call out limited scope (AZ3 only).
incident-bot: status-page-update queued (internal ops channel) — scheduled post sent at 2026-06-07T21:39:02Z.
pagerduty: Addition: page escalated to secondary on-call after ack not resolving within 8m per policy. oncall-next notified.
oncall-next: I'm here, switching into mitigation. collab with kai for a temporary traffic shift for shards served by az3.
kai-runtime: proposing failover policy: mark AZ3 as degraded in the routing table, shift 100% of new traffic to az1/az2 for affected model shards; keep existing KV caches warm where possible.
simon-sre: runbook step: `routectl set-weight --region us-west-2 --zone az3 --weight 0.0 --reason "driver-reset"` — who can execute?
maria-ops: I can run it, but will coordinate with infra to ensure we don't overload az1/az2.
olivia-support: prepping a PSAT (post-status action) message for customers explaining partial degradation and failover.
kai-runtime: running canary reroute for a small subset first (5% traffic) to ensure az1/az2 handle it.
```
# routectl dry-run
routectl set-weight --region us-west-2 --zone az3 --weight 0.05 --dry-run
OK: predicted latency delta: +2-3ms
```
simon-sre: can we also enable temporary fallback to quantized model variant for heavy latency-sensitive routes to reduce GPU pressure?
kai-runtime: yes — adjusting rollout policy for model shards: change runtime config `fallback.variant=quantized-v2` for routing group rg-serve-abc.
maria-ops: executing traffic shift to 5% canary now, monitoring error rates and queue lengths.
incident-bot: Canary reroute executed at 2026-06-07T21:45:08Z.
olivia-support: posted initial status at 21:39. updated with canary note at 21:46.
simon-sre: after 6 minutes canary looks stable. error rate for canary traffic dropped to baseline. moving to 50% now.
kai-runtime: moving to 50% with autoscaler throttle to keep headroom. patching autoscaler config now.
```
$ curl -X POST http://internal-api/scale/override -d '{"region":"us-west-2","min":10,"max":50}'
{"status":"ok","message":"override applied"}
```
maria-ops: 50% done. monitoring metrics: CPU/GPUs in az1/az2 are rising but within headroom.
oncall-next: I will take primary for next 30 minutes and then hand off to simon for long tail. Simon, are you good with that?
simon-sre: yes, I'll take the follow-up. I'll stay on for the postmortem collection and root cause analysis.
pagerduty: Incident P12345 status: acknowledged, mitigation in progress. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes or on operator change.
olivia-support: published customer-facing update v1.1 at 21:56 describing failover and expected next update in 30m.
maria-ops: quick note: suppressed noisy alerts for the affected autoscaling policy to reduce pager fatigue — alerts will resume when CPU > 85% persist.
incident-bot: automations: collected logs and attached bundle /artifacts/P12345-20260607.tar.gz.
kai-runtime: created a temporary nodepool with updated AMI/driver in us-west-2-az3 and provisioning new instances to test driver stability.
simon-sre: next steps: keep AZ3 weight 0 while we confirm node stability, run firmware/drivers tests on new nodepool, and coordinate rolling reimage if stable. schedule RCA meeting for 8am UTC tomorrow.
oncall-next: taking over the active mitigation shift now. simon-sre you retain incident lead for RCA. handing off. :handshake:
simon-sre: acknowledged handoff. thanks all. file any customer impact notes to the incident doc and I'll consolidate.
olivia-support: will follow up with support tickets and close-watches.
incident-bot: P12345 updated: state=mitigated-by-traffic-shift.
pagerduty: Incident P12345: resolved? not yet — monitoring.
maria-ops: final note for now: no broad customer data exposure, just availability degradation for a subset of endpoints. keeping postmortem template updated.
simon-sre: logging end-of-shift summary and attaching links to logs/artifacts. next update at 22:15 or sooner if anything changes. :memo:
